title: Renewal Priority Segmentation Matrix - Q2 Playbook Draft
content:
Spreadsheet view: renewal-priority segmentation matrix (single tab)

Columns:
Account | ARR (USD) | Tier | ICP_fit (0-10) | Deployment_mode | Region | Renewal_date | Past_6mo_usage_pct_change | Support_tickets_90d | Recent_perf_incidents | Contract_len_months | Exec_engagement (Y/N) | Health_signals | QBR_priority_score | Risk_flags | Recommended_playbook | Action_owner | Next_step_deadline

Rows (examples):
Acme Robotics | 1,200,000 | Enterprise | 9 | Private (on-prem) | NA | 2026-05-15 | -6% | 2 | 1 | 12 | Y | low latency regressions flagged; cost spike investigations | 92 | Model-performance-regression; budget-committee review needed | 1) Trigger auto-eval on last 30k queries; 2) Offer dedicated tuning workshop; 3) Propose reserved capacity pilot | Diego Patel | 2026-03-24

Nimble Health | 95,000 | SMB | 5 | Hosted API | APAC | 2026-04-09 | -22% | 4 | 2 | 3 | N | low volume, rising error rate on chat endpoint | 42 | Churn risk (usage down, tickets up) | 1) Escalate to solutions engineering for triage; 2) Short-term credits and weekly check-ins; 3) Renewal outreach 30d prior | Samir Rao | 2026-03-18
Horizon Media | 2,800,000 | Strategic | 10 | Dedicated + Private | NA | 2026-12-01 | +4% | 0 | 0 | 24 | Y | strong exec sponsorship; pilot on new LLM variant | 98 | High-value strategic account; lock-in potential | 1) Enterprise renewal proposal with multi-year discount; 2) Offer expanded SLAs and on-call RTO; 3) Executive QBR + tech roadmap review | Maya Chen | 2026-09-01
Foundry Logistics | 260,000 | Mid-Market | 6 | Hosted API | NA | 2026-03-28 | -3% | 1 | 0 | 12 | N | intermittently low throughput, batching opportunities | 55 | Upcoming budget review | 1) Deliver Optimize report; 2) Recommend batching and caching config; 3) Assign CSM to secure renewal conversation | Jordan Park | 2026-03-05

Scoring notes (how QBR_priority_score is computed):
- Base weight: ARR normalized score (0-40) where top ARR accounts map to 40.
- ICP_fit contributes up to 20 points (ICP_fit/10 * 20).
- Deployment complexity contributes up to 15: Private=15, Dedicated=10, Hosted=5.
- Region strategic multiplier: NA/EMEA/APAC mapping modifiers included (+0 to +3 added to score).
- Health signals (tickets, perf incidents, usage drop) subtract up to 30 points.
- Exec_engagement adds +5 if Y.
- Recent expansion velocity (usage change) adds or subtracts up to 10 points.
- Final score capped 0-100, rounded to nearest integer.

Priority band mapping: 80-100 = Immediate (top priority, week-of outreach + technical playbook); 60-79 = High (30-day runway, cost/tech playbook); 40-59 = Medium (standard renewal cadence, targeted optimizations); <40 = Low (automation-first, self-serve nudges).

Playbook library (short forms referenced in Recommended_playbook column):
- Tech-Triage: SE-led incident triage, run targeted profilings, kernel/runtime patch if needed.
- Cost-Optimize: Redwood Optimize deep-dive, batching, cache, quantization plan, projected unit-cost savings.
- Exec-Sync: VP/Head-level meeting to align roadmap and renewal terms.
- Reserved-Pilot: Offer 3-month dedicated capacity trial with committed ARR uplift proposal.
- Short-Term-Credit: Apply credits tied to baseline performance SLAs for 60 days.

Triage & playbook selection heuristics (working rules):
- If Deployment_mode contains Private and ICP_fit >=8 and ARR > 500k -> prioritize Exec-Sync + Reserved-Pilot.
- If Past_6mo_usage_pct_change < -15% and Support_tickets_90d >=3 -> trigger Tech-Triage + Short-Term-Credit.
- If Recent_perf_incidents >=1 and Health_signals mention latency/regressions -> Tech-Triage + Cost-Optimize.
- If ARR > 1M and QBR_priority_score > 85 -> schedule Exec QBR within 14 days and CC Sales AE.

Operational notes (how CS team should use this sheet in QBR/renewal workflows):
- Weekly refresh: Pull ARR and usage metrics via Salesforce + internal billing job (ETL job id: billing-refresh-2026).
- Health_signals should be fed by observability tag "cs-health" from Redwood Console (query saved as confluence link above).
- Populate "Recent_perf_incidents" from SRE incident list (JIRA project: SRE-INC).
- CS lead assigns Action_owner within 48 hours of identifying Immediate band accounts.
- For High and Immediate bands, create a shared runbook folder under /shared_drives/customer-success/<account-name>/qbr and link in the sheet before outreach.

Open questions and next steps (notes for the team):
- Agree on ARR normalization bucket boundaries for base weight (proposal attached in Confluence page).
- Decide if region should be a multiplier or a separate tag for sales alignment.
- Need automation: compute QBR_priority_score nightly and push Slack alerts for Immediate band (automation ticket: JIRA-6643).
- Draft of email templates for 30d, 14d, and 7d renewal nudges (Amira to own).

Quick checklist for next QBR cycle (CS ops):
1) Run nightly score job and flag Immediate accounts.
2) For each Immediate account: assign Action_owner, schedule Exec QBR, attach playbook and linked artifacts.
3) For High accounts: prepare Optimize report and cost playbook before outreach.
4) Document outcome and update Renewal tracker (sheet id: RTR-2026-Q2-renewals).

Notes-to-self / rough items to finalize:
- Need to populate full customer list (export from CRM) and re-run scoring with live ARR banding.
- Add a column for 'Competitive_signals' (win/loss data).
- Consider color-coding rows in final sheet (red/orange/green) and export CSV for Sales.
